consensus_summary: The reconstructed review record requires aligned estimands and bounded interpretation, with supporting revisions to hypothesis language, literature context, length and presentation.

items.competence_basis: direct comparison of the stated development and frozen specifications

cost_scope.locator: abstract, introduction, methodology, results and conclusion

items.description: The abstract and conclusion mix the development price-control coefficient with the baseline coefficient used in the frozen across-era contrast.

evidence_anchor.quote: With one-session, five-session and volatility controls, its coefficient is -0.00914 ... evaluation coefficient is instead +0.00583

items.suggested_action: Separate the development baseline, price-control robustness and frozen baseline replication wherever the estimates are compared.
items.verification_criteria: Every comparison states that -0.00831 is the development baseline paired with +0.00583, while -0.00914 remains separate development robustness.

target.locator: cause of the across-era coefficient change

cost_scope.locator: abstract, literature, data, results and conclusion

items.description: The manuscript describes temporal instability without consistently separating a measured pipeline change from market, sample-composition, timing or classifier explanations.

evidence_anchor.quote: Together, the failed families and direct contrast establish temporal non-replication and instability under the frozen design.

items.suggested_action: State that the contrast identifies instability in the measured baseline pipeline association and does not identify its cause; name plausible composition and measurement alternatives.
items.verification_criteria: The revised manuscript consistently limits the finding to measured pipeline-level instability and explicitly leaves its cause unidentified.

items.description: The results call H1b rejected even though the declared directional effect is not supported in the frozen evaluation.

evidence_anchor.quote: H1b is rejected under its recorded direction and correction.

items.suggested_action: Use not supported for H1b and keep hypothesis labels consistent in the final summary.
items.verification_criteria: H1b is described as not supported, and the final hypothesis summary identifies the correct development hypothesis label.

items.description: The literature review lacks direct empirical-finance context for out-of-sample predictor instability and post-publication attenuation.

evidence_anchor.check_performed: checked the literature chapter and bibliography for direct predictor-stability framing

items.suggested_action: Add verified predictor-stability studies and distinguish local predictability, out-of-sample failure and publication-related attenuation from the paper's measured non-replication.
items.verification_criteria: The literature chapter cites verified primary metadata and uses it to bound, rather than overstate, the temporal contribution.

items.description: The six numbered chapters contain 12,107 words, materially above the programme's approximate 10,000-word target.
items.suggested_action: Compress repeated secondary trading, risk, transfer and prompt discussion while preserving estimates, uncertainty, nulls, multiplicity, costs and power.
items.verification_criteria: The six numbered chapters fall within ten percent of the approximate 10,000-word target without removing required evidence or limitations.

items.description: Front-matter page numbering duplicates Arabic destinations and the timing-placebo figure uses the malformed label 99.1th.

evidence_anchor.locator: title/front matter and Figure 5.5 timing-placebo annotation

items.suggested_action: Use Roman front-matter numbering and replace the malformed percentile suffix in the generated figure while retaining the underlying statistic.
items.verification_criteria: The PDF has distinct Roman front matter, Arabic main matter and a timing figure labelled 99.1 percentile with unchanged evidence values.
